title: NIST WebBook: Carbon is C, molecular weight 12.0107 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Carbon as C, molecular weight 12.0107 amu, CAS 7440-44-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Carbon, CAS Registry Number 7440-44-0, lists molecular formula C and molecular weight 12.0107 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 12.0000000 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
